name: claude-watermark-remover
description: Remove statistical AI text watermarks (SynthID-style, Claude and Gemini) with your own OpenRouter key, free models included.
long_description: One rewrite by one model that keeps the meaning, structure, formatting and language of your text; links, quotations, amounts and percentages return unchanged. Your text goes only to OpenRouter with your own key. Hosted version without keys, for claude.ai on the web and phones: https://painintheagent.com

tools.name: remove_watermark
tools.description: Rewrite the text so the statistical watermark no longer holds; meaning, layout and protected spans stay.

tools.name: get_configuration
tools.description: Read the configured model and the measured presets.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Create one at https://openrouter.ai/settings/keys. Set a credit limit on the key. It is stored by Claude Desktop and never leaves your computer except to OpenRouter.

model.title: Model
model.description: qwen/qwen3.7-plus (the tested model, about $0.001 per 1,000 characters), qwen/qwen3.8-27b:free (free, slower, often busy) or nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free (free; needs OpenRouter's 'free endpoints may train on inputs' setting).
